scope: Read-only source review of APP017 development-record/seal workflow and reused immutable APP015/APP012 custody helpers. No sealer mutation entry point, application test, build or proprietary code was executed by this review.

findings.original_issue: The initial draft copied whatever current debug binary existed at record time and labeled it compiled_debug_executable, despite the test capture having no binary hash. A stable copy alone could not bind that identity to the earlier test/link invocation.
findings.resolution: Final script labels the file post_test_debug_executable_observation, records a separate observation timestamp, and explicitly states the lack of cryptographic binding to the test invocation or link step. The original test capture is unchanged.

findings.original_issue: The initial draft trusted the summary test-count fields without independently requiring the full pinned log to carry the same success result.
findings.resolution: verified_test_record now checks exit/source status, exact command and log path, nested pins and exactly one 271/42 success result. Both record and seal call it.

findings.detail: Exact sorted current source inventory must equal both test-time inventories, snapshot keys must equal current keys with matching identities, and seal repeats source/test/snapshot checks. Symlinks use link-text identity. The reviewer separately verified the current267 entries in the final integration pass.

APP016 manifest is pinned before recursive verification. Each of the three native findings/manifests/counts is fixed; review inputs are checked at recognized fields and recursively. The final sealer review itself is required, binding this script and its helper identities.

Exclusive output creation and final manifest verification preserve prior evidence and refuse overwrite. The later publication review must pass its input-pin checks before status snapshot/manifest creation. This review does not execute record/seal or validate a publication inventory not yet supplied.

The accepted APP015 executable snapshot is hash-pinned, and the current dist executable must match that identity at record. This is an executable check; the APP017 sealer does not independently reaccept the entire live GUI bundle or perform GUI observations.

limits: This is source inspection plus read-only checks of fixed input headers/identities. The root will perform full recursive integrity during record/seal; this reviewer has not rerun it here.

The sealer is an exclusive evidence recorder, not an all-or-nothing transaction. An interrupted or rejected invocation can leave partial new outputs; no completed seal is claimed until final verification succeeds.
The captured debug identity is deliberately a post-test observation. The full test source/log custody does not retroactively establish test-time binary identity.
Passed scientific/application tests and preserved static findings do not establish Cubase runtime, selected host state, full product fidelity or a new GUI release.
